scope.applicable_only_when: antecedent_mode == EXPLICIT_RULE_REFERENCE and antecedent_rule_ids were source-adjudicated

semantics.reference_identity: Rule IDs are authoritative. Text adjacency MUST NOT create an antecedent edge.

surface_classes.EXACT_FOREGOING_REFERENCE: The target clause is an explicit `前格` continuation. Preserve the source-adjudicated parent ID; do not infer a parent from nearest text.
surface_classes.FOREGROUND_REFERENCE_WITH_SOURCE_LOCAL_C: The target begins with `前格` and retains additional source text as a local continuation/delta. The delta is not automatically compiled merely because the parent is known.
surface_classes.EXPLICIT_SOURCE_LOCAL_ADDITIVE_CONTINUAT: The source explicitly adds a condition to a source-adjudicated parent without using `前格`; currently represented only by CA09-847.

parent_compositions.SINGLE_PARENT: Inherit from exactly one explicit antecedent rule ID.
parent_compositions.SOURCE_BRANCH_UNION_SHARED_QUALIFIER: Apply a local qualifier over alternative source branches. Parent IDs are OR/branch-union context, never implicit AND. Currently required by CA05-473.

blocker_propagation.rule: A dependency target cannot become condition-ready by reference resolution alone if any required parent branch or local continuation remains source-underdetermined.
blocker_propagation.single_parent: Propagate parent unresolved blocker metadata to the target dependency analysis; do not delete or rewrite the parent's blocker.
blocker_propagation.branch_union: Track readiness per parent branch. A shared qualifier does not convert alternative branches into conjunction. Any executable branch would separately require a source-resolved parent and source-resolved local qualifier.
blocker_propagation.local_blockers: All target blockers other than ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY remain independently binding.

readiness_bands.REFERENCE_GATE_ALREADY_RESOLVED_RULE_REA: Reference semantics are already source-resolved and the target has no current activation blocker.
readiness_bands.REFERENCE_GATE_ALREADY_RESOLVED_OTHER_BL: Reference semantics are source-resolved but unrelated target blockers remain.
readiness_bands.DEPENDENCY_ONLY_PARENT_READY: The only current target blocker is ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY and its parent condition is locally blocker-free. This is a Knowledge-side compiler candidate, not an execution unlock.
readiness_bands.DEPENDENCY_ONLY_INHERITS_SOURCE_UNDERDET: The only target blocker is ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY, but its parent remains source-underdetermined; compiler support must propagate that uncertainty.
readiness_bands.DEPENDENCY_COMPILER_PLUS_LOCAL_BLOCKERS: The target has ANTECEDENT_DEPENDENCY plus independent local blockers and remains blocked even if graph traversal is implemented.

required_product_behavior_if_implemented: Consume explicit rule IDs, not text adjacency.
Do not create global semantics from 前格, 更见, 又见, 同时见 or other surface tokens.
Keep branch-local provenance in outputs and tests.
